fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary opposing a proposed Florida sales tax and urging a public referendum, with criticism of the Miami Herald and local business interests; discussion of public vs. private electric power and lobbying influences; local political and civic controversies involving Miami police and city administration; reports and opinion pieces on crime and courts (including drunk driving and perjury), labor/employment concerns, and community recreation programs for youth. Also contains letters to the editor and local advertisements and entertainment listings.
